description: Archive all indexed chunks and remove the install record. With remove_files=True, also deletes git-cloned directories (never local/symlinked). Does NOT delete address book entries — source registry is independent.
embedding_description: Remove an installed knowledge base from the index: archive all of its chunks and drop its install record so it stops appearing in listings and search. With remove_files it also deletes a git-cloned working directory, but never a local or symlinked source. Leaves the address-book source entry intact. Use to retire or tear down a knowledge base you no longer want indexed.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Uninstalled KB name and archived chunk count
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: KB not found in install records.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use list_installed to verify the KB name.
